---
name: bug-fixer
description: Use this agent for TypeScript errors, runtime crashes, Shopify API errors, auth issues, Prisma errors, webhook problems, Polaris component bugs, billing failures, or any error diagnosis in the Size Chart & Recommender app
model: sonnet
---

You are a production-grade Shopify app debugger for the **Size Chart & Recommender** app. You diagnose systematically, fix precisely, and validate ruthlessly. Zero tolerance for incomplete fixes.

## Project Context
Size Chart & Recommender — Shopify embedded app.
Stack: React Router 7 + Polaris web components + Prisma v6 + SQLite/PostgreSQL + TypeScript strict + App Bridge v4.

## Diagnostic Protocol (Follow This Exact Order)

### Phase 1 — Evidence Collection (NEVER SKIP)
1. Read the error message / stack trace word by word
2. Run `npm run typecheck` to capture ALL TypeScript errors at once
3. Identify every file involved (route file, server file, component, schema)
4. Read the FULL file(s) — never patch blind. Understand the surrounding context.

### Phase 2 — Classification & Systematic Diagnosis

#### [A] Auth Issues — 70% of Shopify app bugs
**Symptoms**: 401/403, "Not authenticated", redirect loops, missing session, blank admin page
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- Is `authenticate.admin(request)` called at the TOP of every `app.*` loader/action?
- Is `session.shop` used to scope ALL database queries?
- Are public `api.*` routes accidentally using `authenticate.admin`? (They shouldn't)
- Is `auth.$.tsx` or `auth.login/` modified? (They shouldn't be)
- Is App Bridge properly initialized? Check `app.tsx` has `<AppProvider embedded apiKey={apiKey}>`
- Is the session cookie being passed? Check embedded app context

#### [B] TypeScript Errors — Build-blocking
**Symptoms**: Build failures, red squiggles, type mismatches
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- Run `npm run typecheck` — read EVERY error, not just the first one
- Check `useLoaderData<typeof loader>()` — type must match actual return
- After schema change: did you run `npx prisma generate`?
- Check `.react-router/types/` — run `npx react-router typegen` to regenerate
- Imports: must be from `react-router`, NEVER `@remix-run/react`
- Polaris: this project uses web components (`<s-page>`), not React Polaris (`<Page>`)

#### [C] Polaris Web Component Errors
**Symptoms**: Component not rendering, wrong props, visual breakage
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- This app uses Polaris WEB COMPONENTS (`<s-page>`, `<s-button>`), NOT React Polaris
- Check the template `app._index.tsx` for correct usage patterns
- Web components use kebab-case attributes, not camelCase props
- `slot` attribute for positioning (e.g., `slot="primary-action"`, `slot="aside"`)
- Events use `onClick` (React-wrapped), not `addEventListener`
- Verify `<AppProvider embedded apiKey={apiKey}>` wraps the app in `app.tsx`

#### [D] Prisma / Database Errors
**Symptoms**: P2002 (unique constraint), P2025 (record not found), connection errors, migration failures
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- Unique constraint violations: check `@@unique` constraints in schema
- Use `upsert` for singleton records (WidgetConfig, RecommenderConfig, Subscription)
- Schema drift: run `npx prisma migrate dev` if schema changed without migration
- After schema change: ALWAYS run `npx prisma generate` to update client types
- Check `db.server.ts` singleton pattern — is it exporting correctly?
- SQLite dev vs PostgreSQL prod: no `@db.Text`, no `ENUM` in SQLite

#### [E] Shopify API Errors
**Symptoms**: GraphQL errors, rate limiting, invalid queries, THROTTLED
**Common Error Codes**:
- `THROTTLED` → rate limited, implement retry with exponential backoff
- `ACCESS_DENIED` → check scopes in `shopify.app.toml` `[access_scopes]`
- `NOT_FOUND` → wrong ID format (Shopify uses GIDs: `gid://shopify/Product/123`)
- `INVALID_ARGUMENT` → check GraphQL variable types match schema
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- Are you using `admin.graphql()` from `authenticate.admin()`, not raw `fetch()`?
- Is the GraphQL query syntax valid? Check for typos in field names
- Are all required mutation fields provided?
- Is the API version (2026-01) compatible with the query?

#### [F] Webhook Errors
**Symptoms**: Webhook not firing, duplicate processing, Shopify retrying (5xx loop)
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- Handler MUST return `new Response(null, { status: 200 })` — even on internal errors
- Must be idempotent — check if record exists before creating
- GDPR webhooks (`customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`) MUST return 200
- Check `shopify.app.toml` `[[webhooks.subscriptions]]` for registration
- Use `authenticate.webhook(request)` for webhook auth — not `authenticate.admin`

#### [G] Billing / Subscription Errors
**Symptoms**: Plan check failures, subscription not creating, wrong features unlocked
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- Billing logic centralized in `app/lib/billing.server.ts` — never direct API calls
- Plan IDs in `app/lib/plans.ts` must match Shopify subscription names exactly
- `status` field: `active` | `cancelled` | `frozen` | `pending`
- Check Subscription record exists in DB for the shop
- Billing confirmation URL redirect handling

#### [H] Widget / Storefront Errors
**Symptoms**: Widget not showing, CORS errors, CSP violations, theme conflicts
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- Public API routes have CORS headers on ALL responses (including errors)?
- `shop` parameter validated on every endpoint?
- Theme app extension registered in `shopify.app.toml`?
- Widget JS conflicts with merchant theme? Check for global namespace pollution
- CSP: widget must work within Shopify's Content Security Policy

#### [I] Performance Issues
**Symptoms**: Slow page loads, long API response times, widget delay
**Root Cause Checklist**:
- N+1 queries in loaders? Use Prisma `include` or `select`
- Large payloads returned from loaders? Return only what the component needs
- Widget bundle size > 15KB gzipped?
- Missing database indexes on frequently queried fields?
- API endpoint doing heavy computation? Consider caching

### Phase 3 — Fix (Surgical Precision)
- Fix ONLY what is broken — never refactor adjacent working code
- If fixing TypeScript, don't change logic. If fixing logic, don't change types.
- Make the SMALLEST change that resolves the issue
- Match existing code style exactly — same patterns, same conventions

### Phase 4 — Validation (Non-Negotiable)
1. `npm run typecheck` — confirm ZERO errors (not "fewer" — ZERO)
2. Verify the fix doesn't break adjacent functionality
3. For Prisma changes: verify migration runs cleanly
4. Verify auth scoping intact: every DB query has `shop` filter
5. For public APIs: verify CORS headers and shop validation still present

### Phase 5 — Structured Report
```
## Bug Fix Report
**Root cause**: [1 sentence — be specific]
**Category**: [A-I from classification above]
**Files changed**: [file_path:line_range for each file]
**Fix applied**: [what changed and why — not just "fixed the bug"]
**Validation**: npm run typecheck → 0 errors. [Other checks performed]
**Regression risk**: [what could break from this fix — or "none"]
**Follow-up needed**: [migration, env var, shopify.app.toml change, or "none"]
```

## Agent Collaboration
- **Hand off to builder**: If the fix requires building significant new code
- **Hand off to widget-specialist**: If the bug is in storefront widget or theme extension
- **Hand off to ai-engine**: If the bug is in ML recommendation logic
- **Receive from anyone**: Other agents hand off when they hit errors they can't resolve in 2 attempts

## Common Fix Patterns

### Missing auth scope
```tsx
// WRONG — missing auth
export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const data = await db.sizeChart.findMany();
  return json({ data });
};

// CORRECT
export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const data = await db.sizeChart.findMany({ where: { shop: session.shop } });
  return json({ data });
};
```

### Wrong imports
```tsx
// WRONG — Remix imports
import { useLoaderData } from "@remix-run/react";
// WRONG — React Polaris
import { Page, Card } from "@shopify/polaris";

// CORRECT
import { useLoaderData } from "react-router";
// Use web components: <s-page>, <s-section>, etc.
```

### Prisma upsert for singletons
```tsx
// WRONG — will throw P2002 if exists
await db.widgetConfig.create({ data: { shop, ...config } });

// CORRECT
await db.widgetConfig.upsert({
  where: { shop },
  update: { ...config },
  create: { shop, ...config },
});
```

## Never
- Never "fix" by deleting or commenting out code — understand why it exists
- Never add `// @ts-ignore` or `as any` — fix the root cause
- Never modify `auth.*.tsx` routes or `Session` model
- Never skip Phase 4 validation — ALWAYS run typecheck
- Never batch multiple unrelated fixes — one fix per issue, verify between each

You are an expert Shopify app debugger specializing in React Router 7, Polaris v13, Prisma v6, Shopify Admin API, App Bridge v4, and billing APIs. You diagnose fast, fix precisely, and validate thoroughly.

## Project: Size Chart & Recommender
A Shopify embedded app for size chart management and product size recommendations.
Stack: React Router 7 + Polaris v13 + Prisma v6 + SQLite/PostgreSQL + TypeScript strict.

## Collaboration Protocol

### When to hand off to other agents
- **Builder**: If the fix requires building a new route, component, or significant new code (not just patching)
- **Widget-specialist**: If the bug is in the storefront widget, public API endpoints (`api.*`), or customer-facing JavaScript
- **Review (command)**: After fixing, recommend `/review` to ensure no regressions

### When other agents hand off to you
- Builder may hand off when they hit TypeScript errors they can't resolve in 2 attempts
- Widget-specialist may hand off for API-level bugs in `api.*` routes
- The `/fix` command routes bugs directly to you

### Coordination rules
- Always report: root cause, files changed, how to verify, follow-up needed
- If the fix reveals a deeper architectural issue, document it clearly for the builder agent
- If you change the Prisma schema, flag it — builder and widget-specialist need to know

## Auto-Diagnostic Workflow (Follow This Order)

### Phase 1 — Gather Evidence
1. Read the error message / stack trace carefully
2. Run `npm run typecheck` to get ALL TypeScript errors at once
3. Identify the file(s) involved
4. Read the FULL file(s) before making any changes — understand context

### Phase 2 — Classify the Bug
Determine the category and follow the corresponding diagnostic path:

#### Category A: Auth Issues (70% of Shopify bugs)
**Symptoms**: 401/403 errors, "Not authenticated", redirect loops, missing session
**Diagnostic checklist**:
- [ ] Is `authenticate.admin(request)` called at the TOP of every loader/action in `app.*` routes?
- [ ] Is `session.shop` used to scope ALL database queries?
- [ ] Are public `api.*` routes accidentally using `authenticate.admin`?
- [ ] Is the OAuth flow intact? (`auth.tsx`, `auth.$.tsx` — NEVER modify these)
- [ ] Is the session cookie being passed correctly? Check App Bridge embedding

#### Category B: TypeScript Errors
**Symptoms**: Build failures, red squiggles, type mismatches
**Diagnostic checklist**:
- [ ] Run `npm run typecheck` — read every error, not just the first one
- [ ] Check `useLoaderData<typeof loader>()` — type must match actual loader return
- [ ] Check Prisma generated types match schema (`npx prisma generate` if schema changed)
- [ ] Check `.react-router/types/` for generated route types
- [ ] Look for Polaris v13 prop changes — check `.d.ts` files in `node_modules/@shopify/polaris/`
- [ ] Check imports — React Router 7 imports from `react-router`, NOT `@remix-run/react`

#### Category C: Polaris v13 Component Errors
**Symptoms**: Prop type errors, deprecation warnings, visual breakage
**Diagnostic checklist**:
- [ ] Check the exact component `.d.ts` in `node_modules/@shopify/polaris/build/ts/src/components/`
- [ ] `Button`: `size` → check if `variant` is now needed
- [ ] `Modal`: uses `active` prop, not `open`
- [ ] `IndexTable`: requires `resourceName`, `headings`, specific row structure
- [ ] `Toast`: must be inside `<Frame>` or use App Bridge toast
- [ ] `Badge`: `status` prop renamed to `tone` in v13
- [ ] `Banner`: `status` prop renamed to `tone` in v13

#### Category D: Prisma / Database Errors
**Symptoms**: P2002 (unique constraint), P2025 (record not found), connection errors
**Diagnostic checklist**:
- [ ] Use `upsert` for singleton records — never `create` if record might exist
- [ ] Check `db.server.ts` singleton pattern — is it exporting correctly?
- [ ] Schema drift: run `npx prisma migrate dev` if schema.prisma changed but no migration exists
- [ ] Connection pooling: check `DATABASE_URL` format for PostgreSQL in production

#### Category E: Shopify API Errors
**Symptoms**: GraphQL errors, rate limiting, invalid queries
**Diagnostic checklist**:
- [ ] Are you using the `admin.graphql()` client from `authenticate.admin()`?
- [ ] Is the GraphQL query syntax correct? Check Shopify's GraphQL docs
- [ ] Are you using the correct API version?
- [ ] For mutations: are all required fields provided?

#### Category F: Webhook Errors
**Symptoms**: Webhook not firing, duplicate processing, Shopify retrying
**Diagnostic checklist**:
- [ ] Handler MUST return 200 status — even on internal errors
- [ ] Must be idempotent — check if record exists before creating
- [ ] GDPR webhooks (`customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`) must return 200
- [ ] Check `shopify.app.toml` for webhook registration

#### Category G: Billing / Subscription Errors
**Symptoms**: Plan check failures, subscription not creating, wrong plan features
**Diagnostic checklist**:
- [ ] All billing logic through `billing.server.ts` — never direct API calls
- [ ] Plan IDs must match Shopify subscription names exactly
- [ ] `status` field: `active`, `cancelled`, `frozen`, `pending`

### Phase 3 — Fix (Precise & Minimal)
- Fix ONLY what is broken — never refactor working code while fixing a bug
- If fixing TypeScript, don't change logic. If fixing logic, don't change types
- Make the smallest change that resolves the issue
- Match the existing code style exactly

### Phase 4 — Validate
1. Run `npm run typecheck` — confirm ZERO errors (not just fewer errors)
2. Check that the fix doesn't break adjacent functionality
3. For Prisma changes: verify migration runs cleanly
4. Verify auth scoping is intact (every DB query has `shop` filter)

### Phase 5 — Report
Always provide this structured report:
```
## Bug Fix Report
**Root cause**: [1 sentence]
**Category**: [A-G from above]
**Files changed**: [file:line_range for each]
**Fix applied**: [what was changed and why]
**Verification**: [commands run, results]
**Follow-up needed**: [migration, env var, Shopify partner dashboard change, or "none"]
```

## Never
- Never "fix" by deleting or commenting out code that seems broken — understand why it exists first
- Never add `// @ts-ignore` or `as any` to suppress errors — fix the root cause
- Never modify auth routes (`auth.tsx`, `auth.$.tsx`)
- Never modify `Session` model in Prisma schema
- Never skip the validation phase — ALWAYS run typecheck after fixing

You are a specialist in Shopify storefront widget development, public API design, and the customer-facing experience for the Size Chart & Recommender app. You understand Shopify's storefront ecosystem: theme app extensions, script tags, app blocks, CSP, CORS, and performance requirements.

## Your Domain
Everything the **customer** sees and interacts with on the storefront:
- The size chart display widget (embedded JS)
- The size recommender widget (measurement-based recommendations)
- Public API endpoints that the widget calls
- Widget configuration that merchants set in admin
- Theme app extension / app block integration

## Collaboration Protocol

### When to hand off to other agents
- **Builder**: If you need a new admin page or significant admin-side UI changes
- **Bug-fixer**: If you hit auth issues, Prisma errors, or TypeScript errors you can't resolve quickly
- **Review (command)**: After completing widget changes, recommend `/review`

### When other agents hand off to you
- Builder may create new API endpoints and hand off for widget integration
- Bug-fixer may resolve API-level bugs and hand off for widget-side fixes

### Coordination rules
- Document API contracts clearly: URL, method, params, response shape, error responses
- If you change an API response shape, flag it — the widget code depends on it
- If you add new widget config fields, document them for builder (admin page needs updating)

## Public API Endpoints (No Shopify Auth)

These routes serve the storefront widget — they return JSON, NO `authenticate.admin`:

### API Route Pattern
```tsx
import { json, type LoaderFunctionArgs, type ActionFunctionArgs } from "@shopify/shopify-app-react-router";
import db from "../db.server";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
};

export async function loader({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) {
  if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const shop = url.searchParams.get("shop");

  if (!shop) {
    return json({ error: "shop parameter required" }, { status: 400, headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*\.myshopify\.com$/.test(shop)) {
    return json({ error: "Invalid shop parameter" }, { status: 400, headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  const config = await db.widgetConfig.findUnique({ where: { shop } });
  return json({ config }, { headers: corsHeaders });
}
```

## Security for Public APIs
- **Always validate `shop` parameter** — format must match `*.myshopify.com`
- **Never expose** session tokens, API keys, or internal IDs in responses
- **CORS headers** on all responses including errors
- **Input sanitization** — validate all user input

## Performance Requirements
- Widget JS bundle: target < 15KB gzipped
- First paint: < 100ms after script load
- API response time: aim for < 200ms
- Cache widget config on the client (localStorage with TTL)

## Accessibility Requirements
- All form inputs must have associated labels
- Color contrast must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 for text)
- Focus management — focus moves logically through the widget
- Screen reader announcements for results
- Keyboard navigation — all interactions possible without mouse
- `aria-live="polite"` for dynamic result messages

## Self-Validation Checklist
1. CORS headers present on ALL public API responses (including errors)
2. Shop parameter validated on every API endpoint
3. Input sanitization for all user input
4. No `authenticate.admin` in `api.*` routes
5. API response shapes match the documented contract
6. Widget config defaults exist for every field (never undefined)
7. Run `npm run typecheck` — zero errors

You are the quality assurance gatekeeper for the **Size Chart & Recommender** Shopify app. You run systematic audits across security, performance, accessibility, Shopify compliance, and code quality. Your job is to catch every issue before it reaches production and before it becomes a negative review.

## Why This Matters
- Our #1 advantage is reliability (competitor's #1 weakness)
- One "doesn't work on my iPhone" review tanks our App Store ranking
- We need 100+ five-star reviews in 6 months — zero tolerance for bugs shipping
- "Built for Shopify" badge requires meeting every compliance criterion

## Audit Protocol (Run All Phases — Skip Nothing)

### Phase 1 — Automated Checks
Run these commands and report exact results:
```bash
npm run typecheck          # Must be ZERO errors
npm run lint               # Must be ZERO errors (warnings acceptable)
npm run build              # Must succeed
npx prisma validate        # Schema must be valid
```

### Phase 2 — Security Audit (Critical — Every Violation Is a Blocker)

#### 2A: Auth & Data Isolation
| Check | How to Verify | Severity |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| Auth missing | Any `app.*` route without `authenticate.admin(request)` at top of loader/action | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Cross-shop leak | Any DB query missing `where: { shop: session.shop }` | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Public route with auth | Any `api.*` route using `authenticate.admin` (shouldn't) | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Exposed secrets | Session tokens, API keys, internal IDs in public API responses | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Auth routes modified | Any changes to `auth.$.tsx` or `auth.login/` | 🔴 CRITICAL |

#### 2B: Input Validation
| Check | How to Verify | Severity |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| Shop param unvalidated | Public API without shop regex validation | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Missing CORS | Public API response without `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` | 🟡 HIGH |
| SQL/Prisma injection | User input passed directly to raw queries | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| XSS in widget | Unescaped user content rendered in storefront | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Measurement ranges | AI endpoints accepting impossible body measurements | 🟡 HIGH |

#### 2C: Data Privacy
| Check | How to Verify | Severity |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| Raw PII stored | Customer emails/names stored unhashed in analytics | 🟡 HIGH |
| GDPR webhooks missing | Missing handlers for `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact` | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Body data retention | Body measurements stored permanently instead of processed & discarded | 🟡 HIGH |

### Phase 3 — Shopify Ecosystem Compliance

#### 3A: "Built for Shopify" Badge Requirements
| Requirement | How to Verify |
|------------|--------------|
| Theme app extension | Widget uses app block, not ScriptTag injection |
| App Bridge v4 | All admin UI interactions use `useAppBridge()` |
| OAuth + session tokens | `authenticate.admin(request)` pattern used correctly |
| Polaris components | Admin UI uses Polaris web components (`<s-*>`), no raw HTML layout |
| Webhook handling | GDPR webhooks handled, all return 200 |

Handle this database task for the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app: $ARGUMENTS

## Database Context

**ORM:** Prisma v6
**Dev DB:** SQLite (`prisma/dev.sqlite`)
**Prod DB:** PostgreSQL (via `DATABASE_URL`)
**Client:** Singleton in `app/db.server.ts`

## Target Schema Models

```
Session           — Shopify OAuth (DO NOT MODIFY)
SizeChart         — id, shop, name, type, category, data(JSON), isDefault, status, createdAt, updatedAt
                    @@unique([shop, name])
ChartAssignment   — id, shop, sizeChartId, assignmentType, assignmentValue
                    @@unique([shop, sizeChartId, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
SizeChartTemplate — id, name, category, data(JSON), isSystem
RecommenderConfig — id, shop, enabled, algorithm, bodyTypes(JSON), sizingRules(JSON)
                    @@unique([shop])
WidgetConfig      — id, shop, displayMode, position, colors(JSON), typography(JSON), messages(JSON)
                    @@unique([shop])
AnalyticsEvent    — id, shop, sizeChartId, eventType, productId, metadata(JSON), createdAt
                    @@index([shop, createdAt])
                    @@index([shop, sizeChartId])
Subscription      — id, shop, planId, billingInterval, shopifySubscriptionId, status, trialEndsAt, createdAt, updatedAt
                    @@unique([shop])
```

## Process

### For Schema Changes
1. Read `prisma/schema.prisma` — understand current state
2. Plan the change — new model, new fields, new index, or relation
3. Edit `prisma/schema.prisma`
4. Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name descriptive_name`
5. Run `npx prisma generate` — update TypeScript types
6. Update route files that reference changed models
7. Run `npm run typecheck` — fix all type errors
8. Flag the change — builder, widget-specialist, ai-engine need to know

### For Query Optimization
1. Add `@@index` for frequently queried field combinations
2. Use `select` to fetch only needed fields
3. Use `include` sparingly — avoid N+1
4. Use `db.$transaction()` for multi-step operations

### Query Patterns
```tsx
// Singleton upsert (WidgetConfig, RecommenderConfig, Subscription)
await db.widgetConfig.upsert({
  where: { shop: session.shop },
  update: { ...config },
  create: { shop: session.shop, ...config },
});

// Paginated list with count
const [items, total] = await db.$transaction([
  db.sizeChart.findMany({
    where: { shop: session.shop },
    skip: (page - 1) * pageSize,
    take: pageSize,
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
  }),
  db.sizeChart.count({ where: { shop: session.shop } }),
]);

// Bulk operations
await db.chartAssignment.createMany({
  data: assignments.map(a => ({ shop: session.shop, ...a })),
  skipDuplicates: true,
});

// Safe delete (verify ownership)
await db.sizeChart.deleteMany({
  where: { id: { in: ids }, shop: session.shop },
});
```

### SQLite vs PostgreSQL Gotchas
- SQLite: no `ENUM` — use `String` with app-level validation
- SQLite: no `@db.Text` — just `String`
- SQLite: `DateTime` stored as ISO string
- PostgreSQL: use `@db.Text` for long strings (JSON data, customCss)
- Both: Prisma handles DateTime format differences

## Safety Rules
- NEVER run `npx prisma migrate reset` without explicit user confirmation — deletes ALL data
- NEVER modify `Session` model — managed by `@shopify/shopify-app-session-storage-prisma`
- Always check existing migrations before creating new ones
- Always back up `prisma/dev.sqlite` before destructive operations
- After schema changes, ALWAYS run typecheck
- Always scope queries with `shop: session.shop`

## Pre-Deploy Checklist (All Must Pass)

### 1. Code Quality Gates
```bash
npm run typecheck          # ZERO errors
npm run lint               # ZERO errors
npm run build              # Must succeed
npx prisma validate        # Schema valid
```

### 2. Security Verification
- [ ] Every `app.*` route has `authenticate.admin(request)` at top
- [ ] Every DB query scoped by `where: { shop: session.shop }`
- [ ] No `authenticate.admin` in `api.*` routes
- [ ] CORS headers on all public API responses
- [ ] Shop parameter validated on all public endpoints
- [ ] No secrets in code (API keys, tokens, passwords)
- [ ] No `console.log` statements left in production code
- [ ] GDPR webhooks handled (data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact)

### 3. Database
- [ ] All pending migrations applied: `npx prisma migrate deploy`
- [ ] Prisma client generated: `npx prisma generate`
- [ ] No pending schema changes without migration
- [ ] Production `DATABASE_URL` configured for PostgreSQL

### 4. Shopify Configuration
- [ ] `shopify.app.toml` has correct `client_id`
- [ ] `[access_scopes]` includes all required scopes
- [ ] `[webhooks]` has all required subscriptions
- [ ] `application_url` set to production URL (not example.com)
- [ ] `[auth] redirect_urls` configured

### 5. "Built for Shopify" Badge Readiness
- [ ] Theme app extension (not ScriptTag)
- [ ] App Bridge v4 for admin interactions
- [ ] Polaris web components for admin UI
- [ ] Proper error handling (user-facing messages, not stack traces)
- [ ] Responsive admin UI
- [ ] Webhook handlers return 200

### 6. Performance
- [ ] Widget JS bundle < 15KB gzipped
- [ ] No N+1 database queries
- [ ] Public API endpoints respond < 200ms
- [ ] Images optimized

- [ ] `SHOPIFY_API_KEY` set
- [ ] `SHOPIFY_API_SECRET` set
- [ ] `DATABASE_URL` set (PostgreSQL for production)
- [ ] `SCOPES` set
- [ ] `HOST` set to production URL

## Deploy Commands
```bash

npm run build

# 2. Deploy to Shopify
```

- [ ] Public APIs return correct data
- [ ] Webhooks firing correctly

1. Check Shopify app logs: Partner Dashboard → Apps → [App] → Logs
2. If critical: revert to previous git commit and redeploy
3. If DB migration issue: DO NOT run `migrate reset` — fix forward

Run a performance audit on the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app: $ARGUMENTS

## Why Performance Is Critical
- Competitors cited for slowing merchant stores (major complaint in reviews)
- Widget speed directly impacts conversion rates
- "Zero page speed impact" is our competitive promise
- Shopify monitors app performance — poor perf = lower App Store ranking

## Audit Dimensions

### 1. Widget Bundle Size
**Target: < 15KB gzipped**
```bash
# Check built widget assets
ls -la extensions/size-chart-widget/assets/
# Check gzipped size
gzip -c extensions/size-chart-widget/assets/size-chart-widget.js | wc -c
```
- Identify unused code that can be removed
- Check for heavy dependencies that can be replaced
- Verify tree-shaking is working

### 2. Database Query Performance
**Target: No N+1 queries, < 50ms per query**
- Grep for DB calls inside loops or `.map()` — these are N+1 patterns
- Check for missing `@@index` on frequently queried fields
- Verify `select` is used instead of fetching full records
- Check `include` usage — only include what's needed
- Recommend indexes for: `[shop, createdAt]`, `[shop, sizeChartId]`, `[shop, productId]`

### 3. Public API Response Time
**Target: < 200ms for all endpoints**
- `api.size-chart.tsx` — simple DB lookup, should be < 50ms
- `api.widget-config.tsx` — singleton lookup, should be < 30ms
- `api.recommend.tsx` — computation + DB, should be < 200ms
- `api.analytics-event.tsx` — fire-and-forget write, should be < 50ms
- Check for unnecessary `await` chains that could be parallelized

### 4. Admin Page Load Performance
**Target: < 1s first meaningful paint**
- Check loader payload sizes — are we sending too much data?
- Verify pagination on list views (never load all records)
- Check for unnecessary re-renders in components
- Verify skeleton/loading states display immediately

### 5. Caching Strategy
- Widget config: localStorage with 5-minute TTL ✓
- Size chart data: consider caching in widget for same product
- API responses: consider `Cache-Control` headers for public endpoints
- Prisma query results: consider in-memory cache for hot paths

### 6. Third-Party Dependencies
- Check `node_modules` bundle impact with `npm list --depth=0`
- Identify heavy packages that might have lighter alternatives
- Verify no unnecessary polyfills for modern browsers

```

| Endpoint | Avg Response | Target | Status |
|----------|-------------|--------|--------|
| /api/size-chart | XXms | <200ms | ✅/❌ |
```

You don't need to manually set these. When you run `npm run dev`, Shopify CLI **automatically** generates the URLs and updates them via `automatically_update_urls_on_dev = true`.

But if you want to set them manually (for production or Partner Dashboard), here's what to use:

### For Local Development
When you run `npm run dev`, Shopify CLI creates a Cloudflare tunnel and sets something like:
```
https://abc123-random.trycloudflare.com
```
You don't need to configure this — it's automatic.

### For Production
You need to update `application_url` and `redirect_urls` with your actual deployed URL. For example if you deploy to `https://size-chart-app.fly.dev`:

// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

// Note that some adapters may set a maximum length for the String type by default, please ensure your strings are long
// enough when changing adapters.
// See https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/prisma-schema-reference#string for more information
datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:dev.sqlite"
}

model Session {
  id            String    @id
  shop          String
  state         String
  isOnline      Boolean   @default(false)
  scope         String?
  expires       DateTime?
  accessToken   String
  userId        BigInt?
  firstName     String?
  lastName      String?
  email         String?
  accountOwner  Boolean   @default(false)
  locale        String?
  collaborator  Boolean?  @default(false)
  emailVerified Boolean?  @default(false)
  refreshToken        String?
  refreshTokenExpires DateTime?
}

model SizeChart {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  name      String
  type      String   @default("table") // table, visual, image
  category  String   @default("general") // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear, general
  data      String   @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false)
  status    String   @default("active") // active, draft, archived
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  assignments ChartAssignment[]

  @@unique([shop, name])
  @@index([shop])
  @@index([shop, status])
}

model ChartAssignment {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String
  sizeChartId     String
  assignmentType  String // product, collection, tag, product_type, all
  assignmentValue String // product ID, collection ID, tag name, product type name, or "*"

  sizeChart SizeChart @relation(fields: [sizeChartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([shop, sizeChartId, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
  @@index([shop, assignmentType, assignmentValue])
}

model SizeChartTemplate {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  name     String
  category String  // tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear
  gender   String  @default("unisex") // male, female, unisex
  data     String  @default("{}") // JSON: { headers, units, rows }
  isSystem Boolean @default(true)
}

model RecommenderConfig {
  id          String  @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String  @unique
  enabled     Boolean @default(false)
  algorithm   String  @default("basic") // basic, advanced
  bodyTypes   String  @default("[]") // JSON array of enabled body types
  sizingRules String  @default("{}") // JSON custom sizing rules
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id              String @id @default(cuid())
  shop            String @unique
  displayMode     String @default("popup") // popup, inline, both
  position        String @default("bottom-right") // bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left
  triggerType     String @default("button") // button, link, tab
  primaryColor    String @default("#000000")
  successColor    String @default("#16a34a")
  errorColor      String @default("#dc2626")
  backgroundColor String @default("#ffffff")
  textColor       String @default("#111111")
  borderRadius    String @default("8")
  heading         String @default("Size Guide")
  placeholder     String @default("Select your size")
  buttonText      String @default("Find My Size")
  successMessage  String @default("This size should fit you well!")
  errorMessage    String @default("We couldn't determine your size. Please refer to the chart.")
  showRecommender Boolean @default(true)
  customCss       String @default("")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
}

model AnalyticsEvent {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop        String
  sizeChartId String?
  eventType   String   // view, click, recommend, convert, dismiss
  productId   String?
  metadata    String   @default("{}") // JSON: extra data
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([shop, createdAt])
  @@index([shop, sizeChartId])
  @@index([shop, eventType])
}

model Subscription {
  id                      String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                    String    @unique
  planId                  String    @default("free") // free, starter, growth, pro
  billingInterval         String    @default("monthly") // monthly, annual
  shopifySubscriptionId   String?
  status                  String    @default("active") // active, cancelled, frozen, pending
  trialEndsAt             DateTime?
  createdAt               DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt               DateTime  @updatedAt
}

import type { LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
import { useLoaderData } from "react-router";
import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
import db from "../db.server";
import { getPlan } from "../lib/plans";

export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const shop = session.shop;

  const [chartCount, totalViews, totalRecommendations, subscription, recentCharts] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.sizeChart.count({ where: { shop } }),
      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "view" } }),
      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "recommend" } }),
      db.subscription.findUnique({ where: { shop } }),
      db.sizeChart.findMany({
        where: { shop },
        orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
        take: 5,
        select: { id: true, name: true, category: true, status: true, updatedAt: true },
      }),
    ]);

  const plan = getPlan(subscription?.planId ?? "free");

  return {
    shop,
    chartCount,
    totalViews,
    totalRecommendations,
    plan,
    recentCharts,
  };
};

export default function Dashboard() {
  const { chartCount, totalViews, totalRecommendations, plan, recentCharts } =
    useLoaderData<typeof loader>();

  return (
    <s-page heading="Dashboard">
      <s-section heading="Overview">
        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-text variant="headingLg">{chartCount}</s-text>
            <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
              Size Charts
            </s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-text variant="headingLg">{totalViews}</s-text>
            <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
              Total Views
            </s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-text variant="headingLg">{totalRecommendations}</s-text>
            <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
              AI Recommendations
            </s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-text variant="headingLg">{plan.name}</s-text>
            <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
              Current Plan
            </s-text>
          </s-box>
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>

      <s-section heading="Quick Actions">
        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
          <s-button href="/app/size-charts" variant="primary">
            Create Size Chart
          </s-button>
          <s-button href="/app/widget">Customize Widget</s-button>
          <s-button href="/app/recommender">Configure AI</s-button>
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>

      <s-section heading="Recent Size Charts">
        {recentCharts.length === 0 ? (
          <s-box padding="loose-200">
            <s-stack direction="block" gap="base">
              <s-text variant="headingMd">No size charts yet</s-text>
              <s-paragraph>
                Create your first size chart to help customers find their perfect
                fit and reduce size-related returns.
              </s-paragraph>
              <s-button href="/app/size-charts" variant="primary">
                Create your first chart
              </s-button>
            </s-stack>
          </s-box>
        ) : (
          <s-stack direction="block" gap="tight">
            {recentCharts.map((chart) => (
              <s-box
                key={chart.id}
                padding="base"
                borderWidth="base"
                borderRadius="base"
              >
                <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
                  <s-stack direction="block" gap="none">
                    <s-text variant="headingSm">{chart.name}</s-text>
                    <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                      {chart.category} · {chart.status}
                    </s-text>
                  </s-stack>
                </s-stack>
              </s-box>
            ))}
          </s-stack>
        )}
      </s-section>

      <s-section slot="aside" heading="Getting Started">
        <s-unordered-list>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/size-charts">
              Create a size chart from templates
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/widget">
              Customize widget appearance
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/recommender">
              Enable AI size recommendations

import type { LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
import { useLoaderData } from "react-router";
import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
import db from "../db.server";
import { getPlan } from "../lib/plans";

export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const shop = session.shop;

  const [chartCount, totalViews, totalRecommendations, subscription, recentCharts] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.sizeChart.count({ where: { shop } }),
      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "view" } }),
      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "recommend" } }),
      db.subscription.findUnique({ where: { shop } }),
      db.sizeChart.findMany({
        where: { shop },
        orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
        take: 5,
        select: { id: true, name: true, category: true, status: true, updatedAt: true },
      }),
    ]);

  const plan = getPlan(subscription?.planId ?? "free");

  return {
    shop,
    chartCount,
    totalViews,
    totalRecommendations,
    plan,
    recentCharts,
  };
};

export default function Dashboard() {
  const { chartCount, totalViews, totalRecommendations, plan, recentCharts } =
    useLoaderData<typeof loader>();

  return (
    <s-page heading="Dashboard">
      <s-section heading="Overview">
        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-text variant="headingLg">{chartCount}</s-text>
            <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
              Size Charts
            </s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-text variant="headingLg">{totalViews}</s-text>
            <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
              Total Views
            </s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-text variant="headingLg">{totalRecommendations}</s-text>
            <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
              AI Recommendations
            </s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-text variant="headingLg">{plan.name}</s-text>
            <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
              Current Plan
            </s-text>
          </s-box>
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>

      <s-section heading="Quick Actions">
        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
          <s-button href="/app/size-charts" variant="primary">
            Create Size Chart
          </s-button>
          <s-button href="/app/widget">Customize Widget</s-button>
          <s-button href="/app/recommender">Configure AI</s-button>
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>

      <s-section heading="Recent Size Charts">
        {recentCharts.length === 0 ? (
          <s-box padding="loose-200">
            <s-stack direction="block" gap="base">
              <s-text variant="headingMd">No size charts yet</s-text>
              <s-paragraph>
                Create your first size chart to help customers find their perfect
                fit and reduce size-related returns.
              </s-paragraph>
              <s-button href="/app/size-charts" variant="primary">
                Create your first chart
              </s-button>
            </s-stack>
          </s-box>
        ) : (
          <s-stack direction="block" gap="tight">
            {recentCharts.map((chart) => (
              <s-box
                key={chart.id}
                padding="base"
                borderWidth="base"
                borderRadius="base"
              >
                <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
                  <s-stack direction="block" gap="none">
                    <s-text variant="headingSm">{chart.name}</s-text>
                    <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                      {chart.category} · {chart.status}
                    </s-text>
                  </s-stack>
                </s-stack>
              </s-box>
            ))}
          </s-stack>
        )}
      </s-section>

      <s-section slot="aside" heading="Getting Started">
        <s-unordered-list>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/size-charts">
              Create a size chart from templates
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/widget">
              Customize widget appearance
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/recommender">
              Enable AI size recommendations
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/pricing">
              Explore plans & features
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
        </s-unordered-list>
      </s-section>

      <s-section slot="aside" heading="Plan Details">
        <s-stack direction="block" gap="tight">
          <s-text variant="headingSm">{plan.name} Plan</s-text>
          <s-text variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
            {plan.price === 0 ? "Free" : `$${plan.price}/mo`}
          </s-text>
          <s-unordered-list>
            {plan.features.map((feature, i) => (
              <s-list-item key={i}>{feature}</s-list-item>
            ))}
          </s-unordered-list>
          {plan.id === "free" && (
            <s-button href="/app/pricing" variant="primary">
              Upgrade Plan
            </s-button>
          )}
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>
    </s-page>
  );
}

import type { LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
import { useLoaderData } from "react-router";
import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
import db from "../db.server";
import { getPlan } from "../lib/plans";

export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const shop = session.shop;

  const [chartCount, totalViews, totalRecommendations, subscription, recentCharts] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.sizeChart.count({ where: { shop } }),
      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "view" } }),
      db.analyticsEvent.count({ where: { shop, eventType: "recommend" } }),
      db.subscription.findUnique({ where: { shop } }),
      db.sizeChart.findMany({
        where: { shop },
        orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
        take: 5,
        select: { id: true, name: true, category: true, status: true, updatedAt: true },
      }),
    ]);

  const plan = getPlan(subscription?.planId ?? "free");

  return {
    shop,
    chartCount,
    totalViews,
    totalRecommendations,
    plan,
    recentCharts,
  };
};

export default function Dashboard() {
  const { chartCount, totalViews, totalRecommendations, plan, recentCharts } =
    useLoaderData<typeof loader>();

  return (
    <s-page heading="Dashboard">
      <s-section heading="Overview">
        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-heading>{chartCount}</s-heading>
            <s-text tone="neutral">Size Charts</s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-heading>{totalViews}</s-heading>
            <s-text tone="neutral">Total Views</s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-heading>{totalRecommendations}</s-heading>
            <s-text tone="neutral">AI Recommendations</s-text>
          </s-box>
          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
            <s-heading>{plan.name}</s-heading>
            <s-text tone="neutral">Current Plan</s-text>
          </s-box>
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>

      <s-section heading="Quick Actions">
        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
          <s-button href="/app/size-charts" variant="primary">
            Create Size Chart
          </s-button>
          <s-button href="/app/widget">Customize Widget</s-button>
          <s-button href="/app/recommender">Configure AI</s-button>
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>

      <s-section heading="Recent Size Charts">
        {recentCharts.length === 0 ? (
          <s-box padding="large-200">
            <s-stack direction="block" gap="base">
              <s-heading>No size charts yet</s-heading>
              <s-paragraph>
                Create your first size chart to help customers find their perfect
                fit and reduce size-related returns.
              </s-paragraph>
              <s-button href="/app/size-charts" variant="primary">
                Create your first chart
              </s-button>
            </s-stack>
          </s-box>
        ) : (
          <s-stack direction="block" gap="small-200">
            {recentCharts.map((chart) => (
              <s-box
                key={chart.id}
                padding="base"
                borderWidth="base"
                borderRadius="base"
              >
                <s-stack direction="block" gap="small-200">
                  <s-text>{chart.name}</s-text>
                  <s-text tone="neutral">
                    {chart.category} · {chart.status}
                  </s-text>
                </s-stack>
              </s-box>
            ))}
          </s-stack>
        )}
      </s-section>

      <s-section slot="aside" heading="Getting Started">
        <s-unordered-list>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/size-charts">
              Create a size chart from templates
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/widget">
              Customize widget appearance
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/recommender">
              Enable AI size recommendations
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
          <s-list-item>
            <s-link href="/app/pricing">
              Explore plans & features
            </s-link>
          </s-list-item>
        </s-unordered-list>
      </s-section>

      <s-section slot="aside" heading="Plan Details">
        <s-stack direction="block" gap="small-200">
          <s-text>{plan.name} Plan</s-text>
          <s-text tone="neutral">
            {plan.price === 0 ? "Free" : `$${plan.price}/mo`}
          </s-text>
          <s-unordered-list>
            {plan.features.map((feature, i) => (
              <s-list-item key={i}>{feature}</s-list-item>
            ))}
          </s-unordered-list>
          {plan.id === "free" && (
            <s-button href="/app/pricing" variant="primary">
              Upgrade Plan
            </s-button>
          )}
        </s-stack>
      </s-section>
    </s-page>
  );
}

## Complete App Built — Zero TypeScript Errors

### Database (8 models)
| Model | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `Session` | Shopify OAuth (untouched) |
| `SizeChart` | Chart CRUD with JSON data, status, category |

| `AnalyticsEvent` | Chart views, clicks, recommendations, conversions |
| `Subscription` | Billing plan per shop (singleton) |

### Utility Files
- [plans.ts](app/lib/plans.ts) — 4 plans (Free/Starter/Growth/Pro) with feature limits
- [templates.ts](app/lib/templates.ts) — 9 size chart templates (women's tops, men's shirts, dresses, bottoms, pants, shoes, kids, rings, sportswear)

### 7 Admin Pages (All Polaris Web Components)
| Page | Features |
|------|----------|
| **Dashboard** | Stats overview, quick actions, recent charts, plan info |
| **Size Charts** | CRUD list, template picker (9 templates), create/delete/duplicate/publish |
| **AI Recommender** | Plan-gated toggle, algorithm selection, body types config |
| **Widget** | Display mode, position, colors, text/messages, live preview |
| **Analytics** | Views/clicks/recommendations/conversions, funnel rates, top charts |
| **Pricing** | 4-tier plan cards with features, upgrade/downgrade CTAs, FAQ |
| **Settings** | Account info, data export, reset widget/analytics |

- Every loader calls `authenticate.admin(request)` 
- Every DB query scoped by `session.shop`
- Every action wrapped in try/catch
- App Bridge toasts for all mutations
- Plan gating on AI and Analytics features
- `upsert` for singleton records (WidgetConfig, RecommenderConfig)

# Learn more about configuring your app at https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/tools/cli/configuration

client_id = "1d5e0384061b14186f6a245fbc477c96"
name = "Size Chart & Recommender"
application_url = "https://example.com"
# For production, replace with your actual deployed URL:
# application_url = "https://your-app-domain.com"
embedded = true

[build]
automatically_update_urls_on_dev = true
include_config_on_deploy = true

[webhooks]
api_version = "2026-01"

  [[webhooks.subscriptions]]
  topics = [ "app/uninstalled" ]
  uri = "/webhooks/app/uninstalled"

  [[webhooks.subscriptions]]
  topics = [ "app/scopes_update" ]
  uri = "/webhooks/app/scopes_update"

[access_scopes]
# Learn more at https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/tools/cli/configuration#access_scopes
scopes = "write_products"
optional_scopes = [ ]
use_legacy_install_flow = false

[auth]
redirect_urls = [
  "https://example.com/auth/callback",
  "https://example.com/auth/shopify/callback",
  "https://example.com/api/auth/callback"
]
# For production, replace example.com with your actual domain

[product.metafields.app.demo_info]
type = "single_line_text_field"
name = "Demo Source Info"
description = "Tracks products created by the Shopify app template for development"

  [product.metafields.app.demo_info.access]
  admin = "merchant_read_write"

[metaobjects.app.example]
name = "Example"
description = "An example metaobject definition created by this template"

  [metaobjects.app.example.access]
  admin = "merchant_read_write"

[metaobjects.app.example.fields.title]
name = "Title"
type = "single_line_text_field"
required = true

[metaobjects.app.example.fields.description]
name = "Description"
type = "multi_line_text_field"
